Steak pizza
Jul 2026 • Friends
We ordered the Steak Pizza Napoletana and the Squid Ink Pasta, and both dishes were delicious. The pizza had a flavorful, well-cooked steak topping, while the squid ink pasta was rich, perfectly seasoned, and definitely worth trying. I would personally recommend both.

One downside was that we were traveling with a large suitcase and had to leave it downstairs since the dining area is located on the second floor. It would have been more convenient if there was an easier way for guests with luggage to access the restaurant.

The ambiance was comfortable, making it a nice place to enjoy a meal. The service was okay—staff were courteous, though there wasn't anything particularly memorable about the experience.

Overall, it's a good restaurant with tasty food, and I'd recommend it if you're looking for quality Italian dishes.

It's near Han market, so after eating you can shop after
